## Root Cause
The application pods were running but not passing their readiness probes, resulting in no endpoints being registered for the Service. The readiness probe was configured to hit `http://localhost:80/readyz`, but the nginx container's default configuration doesn't serve this path (returns 404). This prevented containers from transitioning to Ready state.

## Fix Applied
Updated the deployment's readiness probe path from `/readyz` to `/`:

```bash
kubectl replace --force -f /tmp/app-deploy.yaml -n default
```

This change aligned the probe with nginx's actual health endpoint at root path (`/`).

|-------|--------|----------|
